label: Aqua & Seth
_shapeNote: READ THIS BEFORE WIRING THE FIGHT. (1) Seth is obj_purple_enemy — objects.tsv gives `obj_purple_enemy / spr_seth_battle / obj_monsterparent`. There is no obj_seth_enemy. obj_seth_shi_controller and obj_seth_shinobeetle_controller are Seth CAMEOS in unrelated encounters and have nothing to do with this fight. (2) The fight is encounter 223 (gml_Object_obj_dw_cliff_sethaqua_battle_Step_0.gml:327, `scr_battle(223, 3, seth_marker, aqua_marker, 0);`); gml_GlobalScript_scr_encountersetup.gml:852-863 puts obj_purple_enemy in monster slot 0 and obj_aqua_enemy in slot 1. (3) BOTH monsters own a `myattackchoice` dispatcher and BOTH fire in the same bullet phase on turns 1 and 3 — two live obj_dbulletcontroller instances at once. A one-attack-per-turn model does not cover this fight. (4) `enemy` is obj_aqua_enemy because 10 of the 13 monsterattackname announcements live in her Step. The announcement scan over obj_aqua_enemy_* will therefore emit TEN entries with DUPLICATE (name, choice, type) triples: entries 0-3 are the SOLO Aqua fight (encounter 220) and entries 4-9 are this fight. Take the SECOND occurrence of choices 0/1/2/3. See `cut`. (5) The battle-box owner CHANGES mid-fight: Aqua's block runs turns 0-4, Seth's runs turns 5-6 after Aqua is removed. See boxBlock / boxBlockLate / mechanics.

boxBlockLate._note: NOT a gen_attacks.js field — informational. Turns 5-6, after Aqua is removed, the box is created by Seth instead (gml_Object_obj_purple_enemy_Step_0.gml:1201-1214). It is the same 320/170 growtangle with NO maxxscale override, so replaying only Aqua's boxBlock is correct for every turn EXCEPT that Aqua's block also applies the OmegaKnife 3x resize. Seth's OmegaBook/OmegaBookEx run at the default box size.

real.name: KnifeChain
real.evidence: Dispatcher gml_Object_obj_aqua_enemy_Step_0.gml:478-488 (inside the `else if (fight_type == "seth")` arm at :474). Reachable THREE ways from the chooser gml_Object_obj_aqua_enemy_Other_11.gml:28-86. (a) Turn 0 when the carried-over flag is 1: Other_11:38-40 `case 1: myattackchoice = 0;`. (b) Turn 1 as a REPEAT of turn 0 — Other_11:56 guards the turn-1 reroll with `if (turns == 1 && !phasehit)`, so if turn 0's attack CONNECTED the variable is left untouched and turn 0's value fires again. (c) Turn 4 unconditionally: Other_11:78-79 `if (turns == 4) myattackchoice = 0;` — this is the scripted rope setpiece. Note the params differ per turn: :3473 tests `obj_aqua_enemy.fight_type == "seth" && obj_aqua_enemy.turns != 5`, and because Aqua's `turns++` (Step_0:536) runs BEFORE the controller's first Step, turn 4 reads turns == 5 and takes the ELSE branch — knife_setup(..., 50, 8, 0.35) instead of (..., 60, 6, 0.35).

real.name: SupportFire
real.turntimer: none — Seth sets no timer, the turn length is whatever Aqua's simultaneous attack raised it to (floor 90)
real.evidence: Dispatcher gml_Object_obj_purple_enemy_Step_0.gml:1224-1229. Chooser gml_Object_obj_purple_enemy_Other_11.gml:12-13 `if (turns > 0 && turns < 4 && !duck) myattackchoice = 0;`, where `duck` is set at :6-10 by reading `obj_aqua_enemy.myattackchoice == 5`. So it fires on turn 1 always (Aqua's turn-1 choice is never 5) and on turn 3 only when Aqua is NOT ducking, i.e. when turn 2's duck missed. It is suppressed on turn 0 (`turns > 0` fails), turn 2 (duck), turn 4 (`turns < 4` fails), and turn 3 when the duck hit. Ordering is guaranteed: Seth's Step:701-707 runs `with (obj_aqua_enemy) event_user(1);` BEFORE his own `event_user(1);`, so Aqua's choice for the CURRENT turn is already committed when the duck test reads it. Controller branch gml_Object_obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:3556-3565 creates obj_purple_aim_attack at scr_get_box(0)+75 / scr_get_box(5) with `damage = floor(damage * 1.25)`.

mechanics: ONE encounter (223), TWO monsters, a fully scripted 7-turn ladder, no random attack selection anywhere. Plain RED soul throughout — no green/purple/yellow mode, no obj_purplecontrols, no minigame board (grepped: zero soulmode hits in either Step or in any of the attack managers). TURN LADDER (Aqua choice / Seth choice): t0 flag-driven / none; t1 repeat-or-reroll / SupportFire; t2 Duck / none; t3 repeat-or-previous / SupportFire-unless-duck; t4 KnifeChain / none; t5 (Aqua gone) / OmegaBook; t6 / OmegaBookEx; t7 -> retreat + scr_wincombat. TWO CONTROLLERS AT ONCE on turns 1 and 3: Aqua and Seth each run their own `if (rtimer == 12)` dispatcher in the same bullet phase (aqua Step_0:476, purple Step_0:1222) and each calls scr_bulletspawner, so two obj_dbulletcontroller instances are live simultaneously. CROSS-FIGHT INPUT: turn 0 is chosen by `global.flag[1313]`, written by Aqua's `evaluate()` in the EARLIER solo fight (Create_0:56-69, called from Step_0:34 and :156) from whichever of her four attacks hit the player most; the map is Other_11:32-53 flag {0,1,2,3,4} -> choice {4,0,1,2,3}. Flag 0 (never hit) yields the paired-exclusive "Everything". FEEDBACK LOOP: `phasehit` is set true by Aqua's bullet objects on contact (obj_bullet_knife_Other_15.gml:56, obj_omega_knife_Other_15.gml:21, obj_attack_knifefan_bullet_Other_15.gml:40, obj_aquabullet_Other_15.gml:46) and cleared at the end of every chooser run (Other_11:84). It decides whether turn 1 repeats or rerolls, whether turn 3 re-ducks, and which of Seth's two dialogue arms plays (purple Step_0:7-11 `_yep`). BOX OWNER HANDOFF: obj_battlecontroller.attackpriority resets to -1 each turn (scr_endturn.gml:114, scr_mnendturn.gml:28). While Aqua lives she claims it during enemytalk (aqua Step_0:64-65, scr_attackpriority(0)), so Seth's box block — which is gated on `scr_attackpriority(myattackpriority)` with myattackpriority 0 (purple Step_0:1203, :708) — returns false and never runs. Aqua's block is UNGATED (aqua Step_0:368-385) and does the work, including the OmegaKnife 3x resize. After scr_monsterdefeat removes Aqua (purple Step_0:437-438) her Step exits at `global.monster[myself] == 1`, nothing claims priority, and Seth's block takes over for turns 5-6. TURN-4 SETPIECE: Aqua's forced KnifeChain hits SETH. obj_attack_knifechain_manager2_Alarm_1.gml:4-63 makes him jump and shout a seven-line panic sequence ("WE'RE ON THE SAME TEAM--!!") indexed by `rope_counter`, and the writer is forced open with `disablebutton1/disablebutton2/preventcskip` (:56-60). Alarm_1:1-2 and Alarm_2:1-2 both bail when `global.turntimer <= 5`, and Alarm_2:6-7 stops once rope_counter hits 6. This is what drives Aqua's exit. ACT SYSTEM: the paired fight replaces Aqua's six solo ACTs with three party-wide ones (SpinX/PoseX/DanceX, Other_22:16-24) plus S-Action/R-Action simul acts (:29-34); Seth COUNTERS every one after the first — aqua Step_0:739-763 grants 20 mercy only while `seth_counter == 0`, then "But, Seth countered!" and the mercy is taken back (:900-912). Mercy is therefore capped and the fight cannot be spared to completion. HP GATES: both monsters clamp at 10% max HP and set `violence_end` (aqua Create_0:87-94, purple Create_0:56-62), which routes to the alternate endings at purple Step_0:949-1116 (Seth downed) and :1118-1193 (Aqua downed) — either one ends the fight early via scr_wincombat. `noreturn` is forced on turns 0 and 1 (aqua Step_0:530-534).
engineNeeds: 1) SIMULTANEOUS CONTROLLERS — turns 1 and 3 need two independent obj_dbulletcontroller instances alive in one bullet phase, each with its own btimer/made/type. A single-controller harness will drop Seth's SupportFire. 2) TWO ENEMY OBJECTS with independent `turns` counters, both stepping each frame, plus the cross-reads Seth->Aqua (`obj_aqua_enemy.myattackchoice`, purple Other_11:6-10 and Step_0:796-812) and Aqua->Seth (`with (obj_purple_enemy) duck_hit = ...`, aqua Other_11:81-82). Aqua's counter also has to be readable by the controller (dbulletcontroller:3473 reads obj_aqua_enemy.turns) and must already be incremented when the controller first steps. 3) CHOOSER ORDER — both choosers must run from Seth's enemytalk block in the order Aqua-then-Seth (purple Step_0:701-707); running Seth's first breaks the duck test. 4) global.flag[1313] must be selectable input (0-4) to reach all five turn-0 openers, and `phasehit` must be wired from actual player collisions or turns 1/3 will not branch. 5) MID-FIGHT MONSTER REMOVAL — scr_monsterdefeat on Aqua at turn 5 must stop her Step, free attackpriority, and hand the box to Seth. 6) The scan will hand you TEN announcements for obj_aqua_enemy with duplicate (name, choice, type) keys; keys must be disambiguated by source offset or by fight_type, or the solo entries will shadow the paired ones. 7) obj_omega_book_manager must honour `omega_ex_mode` (4x angle_speed_goal, 2x angle_speed_change, 2x scroll_speed_goal). 8) turntimer must be per-attack, not a floor — the values span 180 (Duck) to 480 (OmegaBookEx) against a base of 90, and the KnifeChain value is turn-dependent (260 on turn 4, 240 elsewhere). 9) Only the turn-4 rope sequence needs dialogue mid-bullet-phase (obj_attack_knifechain_manager2_Alarm_1) with input suppression; everything else is ordinary bullet hell. 10) NOT needed: alternate soul modes, minigame boards, custom heart controllers — this fight is plain red soul.
